question: In October 2022, who became the first Indian-origin Prime Minister of UK?
solution:
The correct answer __**Rishi Sunak.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rishi Sunak:-**

 
 
• **He became the first Indian-origin Prime Minister of the United Kingdom in October 2022. (Hence option 3 is correct)**
 
• Sunak entered politics in 2015, when he was elected as the Member of Parliament for Richmond (Yorks).
 
• He was appointed Parliamentary Under-Secretary of State for Local Government in 2018, and then Chief Secretary to the Treasury in 2019.
 
• Sunak is the first British Asian and the first Hindu prime minister of the United Kingdom.
 
• His election is a significant moment for British politics, and it is a testament to the growing diversity of the UK population.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Kamala Harris:-**

 
 
• **She is an American politician and attorney who is the 49th and current vice president of the United States. **
 
• A member of the Democratic Party, she previously served as the attorney general of California from 2011 to 2017 and as a U.S. senator representing California from 2017 to 2021. 
 
 
 
• **Harry Anand:-**
 
 
• He is an American chemical engineer and politician.
 
• **He served as the mayor of Laurel Hollow from 2007 to 2013. **
 
• He was the first Indian-American mayor in the state of New York.
 
 
 
• **Neel Kashkari:-**
 
 
• **He is the president of the Federal Reserve Bank of Minneapolis. **
 
• He is an American banker, economist, and politician. 
 
• He worked as a management consultant at McKinsey & Company before joining the U.S. Treasury Department in 2006.
